question: Using a recursive monthly inventory adjustment model starting from December 2018 inventory levels, where we restock a product if its ending inventory drops below the minimum required level, determine for each product the month in 2019 where the absolute difference between its ending inventory and the minimum required level is the smallest, and return the product_id, that month, and the absolute difference.
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE month_seq(mth, rn) AS (
  SELECT DATE '2019-01-01', 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT mth + INTERVAL '1' MONTH, rn + 1
  FROM month_seq
  WHERE rn < 12
),
products AS (
  SELECT product_id, qty_minimum, qty_purchase FROM product_minimums
),
start_inv AS (
  SELECT product_id, CAST(qty AS DOUBLE) as dec2018_inv 
  FROM monthly_budget 
  WHERE mth = '2018-12-01'
),
monthly_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR) as pid,
    mth,
    CAST(qty AS DOUBLE) as monthly_qty
  FROM monthly_budget
  WHERE mth >= '2019-01-01'
),
inv_model AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    ms.mth,
    si.dec2018_inv as running_inv,
    COALESCE(md.monthly_qty, 0) as monthly_qty,
    p.qty_minimum,
    p.qty_purchase,
    si.dec2018_inv - COALESCE(md.monthly_qty, 0) as raw_inv,
    CASE 
      WHEN si.dec2018_inv - COALESCE(md.monthly_qty, 0) < p.qty_minimum 
      THEN si.dec2018_inv - COALESCE(md.monthly_qty, 0) + p.qty_purchase
      ELSE si.dec2018_inv - COALESCE(md.monthly_qty, 0)
    END as ending_inv,
    ms.rn
  FROM month_seq ms
  CROSS JOIN products p
  JOIN start_inv si ON si.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN monthly_data md ON md.pid = CAST(p.product_id AS VARCHAR) AND md.mth = CAST(ms.mth AS VARCHAR)
  WHERE ms.rn = 1
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    im.product_id,
    ms.mth,
    im.ending_inv as running_inv,
    COALESCE(md.monthly_qty, 0) as monthly_qty,
    im.qty_minimum,
    im.qty_purchase,
    im.ending_inv - COALESCE(md.monthly_qty, 0) as raw_inv,
    CASE 
      WHEN im.ending_inv - COALESCE(md.monthly_qty, 0) < im.qty_minimum 
      THEN im.ending_inv - COALESCE(md.monthly_qty, 0) + im.qty_purchase
      ELSE im.ending_inv - COALESCE(md.monthly_qty, 0)
    END as ending_inv,
    ms.rn
  FROM inv_model im
  JOIN month_seq ms ON ms.rn = im.rn + 1
  LEFT JOIN monthly_data md ON md.pid = CAST(im.product_id AS VARCHAR) AND md.mth = CAST(ms.mth AS VARCHAR)
),
with_abs AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    ending_inv,
    qty_minimum,
    ABS(ending_inv - qty_minimum) as abs_diff
  FROM inv_model
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    abs_diff,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY abs_diff ASC, mth ASC) as rn
  FROM with_abs
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id
